name: codex-research-harness
description: Maintain a lightweight, agent-driven protocol for a single research project.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight project controls for research work.
interface.longDescription: Keeps one research project's intent, stable constraints, directory responsibilities, current state, and one optional task contract recoverable while leaving repository inspection and research procedures to the agent.
defaultPrompt: Adopt this research project and establish its current constraints and directory responsibilities.
Restore the current project context and continue its active task.
Reconcile verified task impacts without creating file inventories or task history.
